services.name: Fire sprinklers
services.description: Design, installation and care for wet, dry, pre-action and ESFR sprinkler systems.
services.detail: From a new construction project to an existing property, start with a system that fits the building and its use. Isak coordinates the design, installation and ongoing service of water-based fire protection.

services.name: Fire alarms & detection
services.description: Addressable and conventional alarms, detection and voice evacuation systems.
services.detail: Connect detection, notification and service in one coordinated approach. Isak supports fire alarm installations and the testing and maintenance that follow.

services.name: Kitchen suppression
services.intro: Keep your kitchen in the conversation.
services.description: Wet chemical suppression for restaurants, hotels and commercial cooking environments.
services.detail: Cooking equipment and suppression coverage need to work together. Isak helps commercial kitchens plan installations, maintain systems and review coverage when the cooking line changes.

services.name: Fire extinguishers
services.description: Extinguisher supply, inspection, recharge and hydrostatic testing services.
services.detail: Keep portable fire protection part of your property's service plan. The team can discuss equipment needs, inspection findings and service options for your extinguishers.

services.name: Systems monitoring
services.description: Central station monitoring for alarms, sprinkler flow and tamper signals.
services.detail: An alarm system is part of a larger response chain. Discuss signal supervision and monitoring for a single property or a coordinated portfolio with the Isak team.

services.name: Fire pumps
services.intro: Support the system behind the system.
services.description: Electric and diesel fire pump installation, testing and ongoing service.
services.detail: Fire pumps are a critical part of many water-based protection systems. Isak supports installation and testing, with service planned around your equipment and applicable requirements.

services.name: Backflow devices
services.description: RPZ and DCVA installation, testing and reporting for water authorities.
services.detail: Backflow devices sit at an important connection between a property's systems and its water supply. Isak helps coordinate device installation, testing and municipal reporting.

services.name: Emergency & exit lighting
services.intro: Make the way out a priority.
services.description: Installation, testing and care for emergency lighting and exit signs.
services.detail: Include emergency lighting in your building's life-safety program. Isak supports equipment installation, operational testing and the documentation needed for your property.

services.name: Fire suppression
services.description: Clean agent, CO₂, foam and inert gas systems for specialized environments.
services.detail: Different spaces present different protection needs. Isak works with special hazard applications, including data centers and industrial facilities, to discuss an appropriate suppression approach.

faqs.q: What can Isak Fire Protection help with?
faqs.a: The team supports commercial, industrial and residential properties across nine fire protection disciplines. Explore the service directory, then contact Isak to confirm availability for your property.

The website lists Chicago, Toronto, Detroit, Dayton, Indianapolis and Milwaukee, serving Illinois, Ontario, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. Confirm the service scope for your address with the local team.

faqs.q: How do I request an estimate?
faqs.a: Call (312) 445-7787 or email sales@isakfire.com. You can also use the guided quote planner to prepare your project details and open an email draft for review.
Published office hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Contact the team during business hours for general inquiries and service scheduling.

faqs.q: How often should my systems be inspected?
faqs.a: Inspection and testing schedules vary by system, component, adopted code, manufacturer and local authority. Ask Isak to review the requirements that apply to your property and create an appropriate schedule.

NFPA 25 addresses inspection, testing and maintenance of water-based fire protection systems. The applicable edition and local requirements should be confirmed with the authority having jurisdiction and your service professional.

faqs.q: What happens when an inspection finds a deficiency?
faqs.a: Isak documents findings and can discuss corrective work. The required response and timing depend on the deficiency and local requirements. Ask your service team to explain the report and the next steps for your property.

faqs.q: How long will an inspection take?
faqs.a: The scope depends on the building, system size, number of devices and access. Discuss the schedule and operational considerations with the team before the visit.
Isak's published service information includes inspection reports and certificates. Confirm the records included in your scope so your property team knows what to expect.

faqs.q: Do you work on new construction and retrofits?
faqs.a: Yes. Isak describes support for new construction, existing-building retrofits, system expansions and tenant improvements, including coordination with architects and general contractors.

faqs.q: How is an installation schedule determined?
faqs.a: Building size, system complexity, permitting and access all affect the schedule. Isak can review your project and establish a plan before work begins.

faqs.q: Can work be coordinated around business operations?
faqs.a: Discuss occupied-building requirements early. Depending on the project, phased work and agreed access windows may help reduce disruption; the team will confirm what is practical and safe.

faqs.q: Do you coordinate permits and local authorities?
faqs.a: Isak's website describes permitting, plan review submissions and coordination with the authority having jurisdiction as part of its project services. Confirm those responsibilities in your proposal.

faqs.q: When should kitchen suppression be serviced?
faqs.a: Service intervals depend on the system, manufacturer, applicable requirements and local authority. Ask the team to confirm the schedule for your kitchen and keep the service records available.

faqs.q: What if I move or add cooking equipment?
faqs.a: Have the suppression coverage reviewed before changing the cooking line. Appliance positions and equipment changes can affect system suitability and nozzle coverage.

UL 300 is a fire-test standard for systems protecting commercial cooking equipment. Ask your qualified system provider to explain how the equipment, listing and installation requirements apply to your kitchen.

faqs.q: Can I arrange a recurring service program?
faqs.a: Isak offers inspection and maintenance agreements. Discuss the systems included, service schedule, reporting, pricing and terms directly with the team.

faqs.q: How can I pay an invoice?
faqs.a: Use the Pay an invoice link to open Isak's existing Stripe payment page. Confirm your invoice details before paying. This design preview does not process payments.

faqs.q: Do you work with property management portfolios?
faqs.a: Yes. The published offering includes portfolio reporting, consolidated invoicing and account coordination for property and facility managers. Ask the team to confirm the services for your locations.
